properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used for JWT token generation and validation.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.model
properties.description: Ollama embedding model to use for generating vector embeddings (e.g., all-minilm, nomic-embed-text).

properties.name: app.similarity.rag-threshold
properties.description: Minimum similarity threshold for RAG context retrieval (0.0 to 1.0). Higher values = more precise, fewer documents.

properties.name: app.similarity.conversation-threshold
properties.description: Minimum similarity threshold for conversation search (0.0 to 1.0). Can be less restrictive than RAG.

properties.name: app.similarity.default-threshold
properties.description: Default minimum similarity threshold for general document searches (0.0 to 1.0).
